'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[President of Iran|Iranian president]] [[Masoud Pezeshkian]] says that [[Iran]] has the "necessary will" to end the war, provided that the "guarantees required to prevent repetition of the aggression" are met. [https://www.rferl.org/a/pezeshkian-iran-peace-us-war-talks/33721776.html (RFE/RL)]
****[[Foreign Minister of Iran|Iranian foreign minister]] [[Abbas Araghchi]] confirms that direct contacts, although "not negotiations", with [[United States Special Envoy|U.S. special envoy]] [[Steve Witkoff]] are under way. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/31/no-truth-to-us-iranian-negotiations-irans-fm-tells-al-jazeera (Al Jazeera)]
****[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] says that [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. forces]] plan to end operations in Iran within about two to three weeks while continuing military action, stating that the withdrawal is not contingent on reaching an agreement with Iran. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20260331-trump-says-us-to-leave-iran-very-soon-deal-or-not (AFP via RFI)]
****[[United States Secretary of Defense|U.S. defense secretary]] [[Pete Hegseth]] says that the talks between Iran and the [[United States]] "are very real" but also states that the U.S. will "negotiate with bombs" until a [[ceasefire]] is reached. [https://time.com/article/2026/03/31/hegseth-says-us-will-negotiate-with-bombs-until-iran-cease-fire-deal/ (''Time'')]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****The [[Kuwait Petroleum Corporation]] claims that [[oil tanker]] ''Al Salmi'' has been hit by an [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|Iranian drone]] at a port in [[Dubai]], causing a fire onboard and damage to the vessel. Dubai authorities say that the fire has been contained hours after the incident. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/mar/31/kuwaiti-tanker-hit-by-iranian-attack-in-dubai-port-raising-oil-spill-fears (''The Guardian'')]
***[[France–Israel relations]]
****The [[Israeli defense ministry]] halts sales of defense products to [[France]] following [[President of France|president]] [[Emmanuel Macron]]'s decision not to allow [[United States Air Forces|U.S. aircraft]] to pass through French [[airspace]] en route to [[Israel]]. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-891742 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[Italy–United States relations]]
****[[Italy]] denies the [[United States Air Force]] the use of the [[Naval Air Station Sigonella|Sigonella base]] in [[Sicily]] for operations related to the Iran war. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/italy-refuses-us-aircraft-use-sicily-base-middle-east-operations-source-says-2026-03-31/ (Reuters)]
***[[Poland–United States relations]]
****[[Poland]] refuses a request by the [[United States]] to relocate its [[MIM-104 Patriot|Patriot air defense systems]] to the [[Middle East]] for the Iran war. [https://www.politico.eu/article/poland-wont-divert-patriot-air-defense-systems-to-gulf/ (''Politico'')]
***[[China]] and [[Pakistan]] release a five-point [[peace plan]] for the Iran war following a meeting between the two countries' [[foreign minister]]s, [[Wang Yi]] and [[Ishaq Dar]], respectively. The plan includes a ceasefire and reopening the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/mar/31/pakistan-china-propose-five-part-peace-plan-middle-east (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.axios.com/2026/03/31/china-pakistan-iran-peace-deal-strait-ceasefire (Axios)] [https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/eng/wjbzhd/202603/t20260331_11884511.html (Chinese Foreign Ministry)]
**[[2026 Lebanon war]]
***[[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Israeli defense minister]] [[Israel Katz]] announces that Israel will destroy "all houses" near the [[Blue Line (withdrawal line)|Blue Line]] as part of its creation of a new [[buffer zone]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-destroy-all-houses-near-lebanon-border-defence-minister-says-2026-03-31/ (Reuters)]
***Four [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli soldiers]] are [[killed in action]] while fighting [[Hezbollah]] in [[southern Lebanon|southern]] [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-891727 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**[[Iraqi conflict]]
***[[Americans|American]] [[Freelancer|freelance]] journalist [[Shelly Kittleson]] is [[Foreign hostages in Iraq|kidnapped]] by armed men in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yled478zwo (BBC News)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Seven dismembered bodies are found on a road in [[Cualac (municipality)|Cualac]], [[Guerrero]], [[Mexico]]. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2026/04/7-dismembered-bodies-found-dumped-on-road-in-southern-mexico/ (BNO News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iran war fuel crisis]]
***The [[American Automobile Association]] reports that the [[Energy in the United States|United States]] national average gas price has reached [[United States dollar|$]]4.02 a gallon, the highest since [[Global energy crisis (2021–2023)|2022]] following [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|Russia's invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://apnews.com/article/gas-prices-4-gallon-iran-war-de8b7ccea254a1585cab86f336db57a6 (AP)]
**The [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]] surges over 1,000 points and the [[Nasdaq]] increases to 3.4% after [[President of Iran|Iranian president]] [[Masoud Pezeshkian]] says that [[Iran]] has signaled it is willing to end the conflict if security guarantees and assurances are met. [https://moneycheck.com/dow-surges-over-1000-points-as-iran-signals-willingness-to-end-u-s-conflict/ (Moneycheck)] [https://www.xtb.com/int/market-analysis/news-and-research/breaking-markets-surge-following-the-iranian-president-s-statement-about-a-possible-end-to-the-conflict (XTB)]
**Stocks in the U.S. also rise following reports that [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] has told aides that he is willing to end the war without securing the Strait of Hormuz. [https://qz.com/stocks-markets-iran-war-trump-strait-hormuz-dow-sp500-nasdaq (Quartz)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Crimea Antonov An-26 crash]]
**Thirty military personnel are killed when a [[Russian Air Force]] [[Antonov An-26]] crashes in [[Crimea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/russian-military-transport-crashes-crimea-29-killed-defence-ministry-says-2026-03-31/ (Reuters)] [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/04/01/at-least-30-dead-after-russian-military-transport-plane-crashes-in-annexed-crimea-a92395 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*Dozens of people are killed and many others are injured after multiple explosions occur at a [[Burundi National Defence Force|military]] [[ammunition depot]] in [[Bujumbura]], [[Burundi]], causing extensive damage to nearby residential areas. [https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/world/article/2001544349/dozens-killed-in-burundi-after-arsenal-fire-security-sources (AFP via ''The Standard'')]
*Eleven people are killed in a [[shophouse]] complex fire in [[Wamena]], [[Highland Papua]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://sorongraya.inews.id/amp/681820/11-orang-tewas-dalam-kebakaran-empat-ruko-di-kota-wamena (iNews)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBTQ rights in the United States]], [[Legality of conversion therapy]]
**''[[Chiles v. Salazar]]''
***The [[United States|U.S.]] [[Supreme Court of the United States|Supreme Court]] overturns [[LGBTQ rights in Colorado|Colorado]]'s ban on [[conversion therapy]] in an 8–1 decision, ruling that it infringed on the [[First Amendment to the United States Constitution|First Amendment]], thereby invalidating similar bans in 22 other [[States of the United States of America|states]]. [https://apnews.com/article/supreme-court-conversion-therapy-colorado-92b34295f9ef497a4a1cbeb56c9b74c6 (AP)] [https://www.cpr.org/2026/03/31/supreme-court-overturns-colorado-ban-on-conversion-therapy/ (Colorado Public Radio)]
*[[LGBTQ rights in Senegal]]
**[[Senegal]]ese [[President of Senegal|president]] [[Bassirou Diomaye Faye]] approves a law increasing penalties for [[Homosexual sexual practices|same-sex sexual acts]] to up to 10 years in prison and [[Criminalization of homosexuality|criminalizing]] the promotion or financing of such acts. The measure amends existing provisions in the penal code that already penalize these acts. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/senegal-president-backs-new-anti-lgbt-law-banning-promotion-2026-03-31/ (Reuters)]
*A [[Judiciary of Brazil|court]] in [[Rio de Janeiro (state)|Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]], nullifies a fine of more than [[Brazilian real|R$]]16 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]3 million) imposed on [[Football in Brazil|football]] player [[Neymar]] in 2023 over alleged [[Environmental governance in Brazil|environmental violations]] linked to construction at his [[Mangaratiba]] property, citing procedural flaws in the investigation. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20260331-brazil-court-quashes-neymar-environmental-damage-fine (AFP via RFI)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Cricket in Pakistan|Pakistani cricketer]] [[Naseem Shah]] receives a record fine of [[Pakistani rupee|Rs.]] 20 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]71,500) for a [[Mass media in Pakistan|social media]] post criticizing [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]] [[Chief Minister of Punjab (Pakistan)|chief minister]] [[Maryam Nawaz]], while other disciplinary cases arise in the [[Pakistan Super League]], including a fine for [[Shaheen Shah Afridi]] and a [[Ball tampering|ball-tampering]] charge against [[Fakhar Zaman (cricketer)|Fakhar Zaman]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260331-pakistan-cricketer-naseem-fined-record-71-500-for-minister-criticism (AFP via France 24)]
